function.text: KLLN encodes killin. It is a DNA-binding protein involved in S phase checkpoint control-coupled apoptosis by mediating p53/TP53-induced apoptosis. It has the ability to inhibit DNA synthesis and S phase arrest coupled to apoptosis. It has affinity to both double- and single-stranded DNA.
